sloka: स्तनौ चाविरलौ पीनौ ममेमौ मग्नचूचुकौ ।मग्ना चोत्सङ्गिनी नाभिः पार्श्वोरस्काश्च मे चिताः ।। ६.४८.११ ।।।।
transliteration: stanau cāviralau pīnau mamemau magnacūcukau ।magnā cotsaṅginī nābhiḥ pārśvoraskāśca me citāḥ ।। 6.48.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "My breasts are well formed and developed, the nipples are depressed and joined, the navel is deep, and the surrounding part is fleshy."
translations.hindi: और निरपेक्ष हो वह विशालनयनी स्वयं मेरे पास चली आवेगी । दुष्ट रावण के इन वचनों को सुन,
